test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Jack played hide and seek.

options.text: Hide and seek was played by Jack.
Hide and seek had been played by Jack.
Hide and seek will be played by Jack.
Hide and seek is played by Jack.

solution:
The correct answer is **Hide and seek was played by Jack.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice is Hide and seek was played by Jack.
 
• The given sentence is in the past i
